value.message: These settings allow you to edit the preset name, description, controller, component, and some repeater settings.
Edit the basic settings of the preset.
The controller that the component will be connected to.
To make a preset for a repeater, choose Repeater as the component.
Set a parent repeater preset if this will be used inside of a repeater which is using a preset.
The repeater preset that this preset would be used with.
